title: Ark Kibble
description: Ark Kibble like be Ark Survival Evolved/Ascended as Minecraft Mod. Allow to players eat kibble but you can make own datapack for any mobs to tame as Ark Kibble
body:
ARK KIBBLE in Ark Survival Evolved/Ascended as Minecraft Mod.



Allow to players eat use kibble. if you don't know recipes? you MUST use JEI. Kibble allowed to taming any mobs or pets from need data pack

Dry Kibble: Restores 2 hunger, 20% saturation

Basic Kibble: Restores 3 hunger, 40% saturation

Simple Kibble: Restores 4 hunger, 50% saturation

Regular Kibble: Restores 5 hunger, 60% saturation

Superior Kibble: Restores 6 hunger, 80% saturation

Exceptional Kibble: Restores 7 hunger, 100% saturation

Extraordinary Kibble: Restores 8 hunger, 120% saturation
